_source: AIP Greece ENR 1.11 'Addressing of flight plan messages' (21 MAR 2024), aerodrome AFS entries from AD 1.6 / AD 2 sections (AIRAC AMDT 09/26 archive in aip/); cross-checked against the Aeroclub Mesogeion 'Common AFTN Addresses' table (https://www.mesogeion-aeroclub.gr/ViewFlightSchedule.php, 15 Nov 2026).
rules: Always: the ACC/FIC of every ACC area the route is in: ATHINAI ACC -> LGGGZFZX, LGGGYXYK; MAKEDONIA ACC -> LGMDZFZX, LGMDYXYK (above FL195: ZQZX instead of ZFZX; not used for VFR here).
Plus, for each TMA/MTMA the route enters below the listed level: the TMA addresses below.
Plus, for each aerodrome whose CTR or ATZ the route enters, and for the departure, destination and alternate aerodromes: <ICAO>ZTZX and <ICAO>ZPZX, with the aerodrome overrides below.
DEP and ARR messages are issued by the departure/destination ATS unit, not the filer (ENR 1.11.2.1).

tma.name: ATHINAI TMA
tma._note: Between FL195 and FL245: LGATZAZX instead of LGATZAZV (not VFR).

LGMG._source: Club table uses LGMGZTZX + LGMGYFYX; AD 1.6.18 lists AFTN LGMGYFYX (HASP) and LGMGYXYX (MIL). Megara has no ARO, so ZPZX is replaced by the HASP AFS address.

aerodromeAfs._comment: Each aerodrome's own AFS address as published in its AD 1.6 / AD 2 entry (for reference; the ENR 1.11 rule uses ZTZX/ZPZX).

clubComparison.agrees: All 48 addresses in the club table follow ENR 1.11: ZTZX/ZPZX for the 17 listed aerodromes, the 7 TMA addresses (LGTG, LGBL, LGSK, LGSY, LGKL, LGMK, LGMT, plus LGAD and LGTS), Athinai TMA below FL195 (LGATZAZV, LGAVZTZX, LGAVZPZX) and both ACC/FIC pairs.
clubOnly: LGMGYFYX (Megara: HASP AFS address used instead of LGMGZPZX; consistent with AD 1.6.18)
missingFromClubTable: ZTZX/ZPZX of any other aerodrome whose CTR/ATZ is entered, e.g. LGKR, LGIR, LGRP, LGSR, LGKO, LGSA
notes: The club lists only the FL195 variant for Athinai TMA, which is the right one for VFR.
Tatoi publishes its own AFS address LGTTYXYX in AD 1.6.5; the club (and ENR 1.11) use LGTTZTZX + LGTTZPZX.
